entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF778-12B. This is ridiculous.

I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up that order. Okay, I see it here. I understand you're frustrated. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Are you kidding me? It doesn't matter what the issue is! I've been dealing with a family emergency! My son had to have emergency surgery, we've been in and out of the hospital for weeks, and my husband is away on deployment! I don't have time to play with gadgets. I want my money back. Now!
I am so sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly stressful, and I apologize for the extra hassle. Please, allow me to handle this for you. I just need to check the return eligibility.

You'd better. I'm a VIP member and I've spent a fortune with VeloFit. If you don't process this refund, I'm blasting you all over social media. This is my final attempt before I call my credit card company. Get me your manager!

I understand your frustration, and I see your VIP status here. We truly value your business. There's no need for a manager, I assure you I can resolve this for you right now. Let me just confirm the policy. One moment.

Okay, I've got it. I'm looking at our internal knowledge base, and it states that all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You received the band 41 days ago, so you are well within that window. My apologies for the confusion.
Well, finally! Common sense. So you're giving me a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I am processing a full refund to your original payment method as we speak. On behalf of VeloFit, I'd like to sincerely apologize for the difficult experience you've had, both with this call and with your family's recent emergency. I'm generating a prepaid return label and it will be in your inbox in the next two minutes.
And as a small apology for the trouble, and to thank you for being a loyal VIP member, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account. There's no expiration on that.
A $50 credit? Fine. That's better. Just make sure that email comes through.
It's on its way to you now. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I truly hope your son has a speedy recovery from his surgery.
